ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the title in the image is “Food Chain”. In the upper right corner there is a bright sun, and sunlight shines downward to the vicinity of the phytoplankton labeled “phytoplankton”. In the water, phytoplankton, zooplankton, small fish, mackerel, mahi mahi, and large shark are labeled in sequence, and there are red arrows indicating the flow of energy in the food chain; at the bottom there is also a large red arrow labeled “Flow of Energy”. Then reason: in a food chain, the initial source of energy is sunlight; the sun provides energy to producers such as phytoplankton. Therefore, what produces or provides energy is the sun.
